test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which of the following years did the resolution at the Karachi Session of the Indian National Congress dwell on how Independent India's Constitution should look?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1931.**__

__***Key Points__**

__
 
• **In 1931, **the Karachi Session of the Indian National Congress dwell on how Independent India's Constitution should look.
 
• Karachi Resolution,1931 on Fundamental Rights guaranteed:
 
 
• Free speech and expression. 
 
• Right to form associations.
 
• Right to assemble. 
 
• Universal adult franchise. (Right to vote) 
 
• Equal legal rights irrespective of caste, creed, and sex.
 
• The neutrality of the state in religious matters.
 
• Free and compulsory primary education.
 
• Protection of culture, language, and the script of minorities and linguistic groups.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Karachi Congress Session w**hich was held from March 26 to 31,1931 was chaired by **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.**
 
• ​Pandit Jawahar Lal Nehru drafted the resolution of the Fundamental Rights and National Economic programme. *
 
• It was a very special session of the Indian National Congress in which Mahatma Gandhi was selected to represent the Indian National Congress in the Second Round Table Conference to be held in London.
 
• The session also discussed the approval of the Gandhi-Irwin Pact or the Delhi Pact.
 
• Six days before this session, Bhagat Singh, Rajguru, and Sukhdev were hanged.
